mundaka_chapter1_verse4.title: Mundaka Chapter 1 Verse 4
mundaka_chapter1_verse4.introduction: This verse belongs to Mundaka, Chapter 1.
mundaka_chapter1_verse4.scripture_text: A representative contemplative passage from the Mundaka Upanishad, Chapter 1, Verse 4, reflecting the inquiry into Atman, Brahman, and liberation through self-knowledge.
mundaka_chapter1_verse4.philosophical_explanation: This verse extends the contemplative teaching tradition of the Upanishads toward self-knowledge and liberation.
